title: Director, Manufacturing Operations & Continuous Improvement
text:
**Lead the Operation. Elevate the System. Grow the People.**
============================================================

Imagine starting your day on the production floor—checking safety, huddling with supervisors, scanning your ERP dashboard, and walking a focused gemba to spot the next opportunity. By afternoon, you're aligning capacity plans to customer demand, unblocking material flow, and celebrating wins from a cross-functional Kaizen. This is the rhythm of our Director, Manufacturing Operations & Continuous Improvement.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* Build, coach, and mentor a high-performing team of supervisors, leads, and skilled production personnel.
* Champion a culture that prizes safety, quality, accountability, and teamwork.
* Advance engagement through cross-training, development pathways, and clear performance expectations.
* Own production planning, scheduling, and capacity management to meet cost, quality, and delivery goals.
* Ensure on-time manufacturing and shipment while upholding rigorous quality standards.
* Lead Lean, Six Sigma, and CI roadmaps to lift throughput, reduce waste, and standardize best practices.
* Optimize processes to increase productivity and lower cost-to-serve.
* Manage material flow, inventory health, and operational KPIs end-to-end.
* Use ERP and data analytics to drive decisions and uncover improvement opportunities.
* Collaborate with senior leadership on long-range manufacturing strategies and investments.
* Recruit, develop, and retain exceptional manufacturing talent.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, or a related technical field; or commensurate experience.
* 10+ years leading manufacturing operations with oversight of multiple production teams.
* Demonstrated success running large-scale operations and developing top-performing teams.
* Deep experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Quality Systems, and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on expertise with ERP, production planning, scheduling, and inventory management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and sound decision-making skills.
* Excellent communicator and people leader.
* Proven ability to drive accountability while fostering a collaborative, positive workplace.

### **Preferred**

* Background in machining, welding, finishing, powder coating, assembly, or similar processes.
* Ability to read and interpret manufacturing drawings and specifications.
* History of improving productivity, quality, on-time delivery, and employee engagement.

**Who Thrives Here**
--------------------

A visible, floor-engaged leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You enjoy solving problems shoulder-to-shoulder with your team and creating an environment where people perform, grow, and stay.

**About Amatrol**
-----------------

We equip learners and employers with hands-on training systems, interactive eLearning, simulators, curriculum, and certification resources that turn complex technology into practical skill. Our U.S.-made solutions serve schools, colleges, training centers, and industry across manufacturing, automation, robotics, electrical systems, oil and gas, packaging, and more—bridging learning and doing for today’s technical careers.

**Your Toolkit**
----------------

* Leadership / People Management
* Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
* Quality Control Experience
* Six Sigma Experience
* Production Planning & Scheduling
* Excellent Communication Skills
* Root Cause Analysis
* Process Development
* Blueprint Reading
* Microsoft Excel
* ERP Systems
* Hands On Leadership Style
* ISO 9001
* Manufacturing Leadership
* metal fabrication
* Microsoft Outlook
* Multiple Department Leadership
* Problem Solving
* Reporting
* Understanding Manufacturing Processes
* electronic assembly leadership

### **Tools You’ll Use**

* ERP Software

**Ready to Lead?**
------------------

If you’re eager to scale performance and build a best-in-class operation, we’d love to talk.

Please Note: This is a fully in-person position in Jeffersonville, IN. To be considered for this position, candidates must submit a current, chronological resume showing relevant work experience as well as a relevant digital portfolio. Contact Human Resources if you need any accommodations during the job application process due to a disability. Amatrol, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

This position is not eligible for placement by outside recruitment or staffing agencies.
